title: GoldenEye 007
shortDescription: A mission-driven first-person shooter whose objectives, stealth options, and local multiplayer helped define the N64’s social identity.
highlights: Objective-based missions that reward observation and restraint
Local multiplayer built around readable arenas and asymmetric tactics
